_notes: Condition list for the drug-disease check. Every ICD-10-CM code and code prefix was checked against the official CMS FY2027 ICD-10-CM code description file on the date in each condition's `verifiedOn` field; `codeDescriptions` holds the official description of each. A value such as "I50" is a category header used as a prefix that covers every code beneath it. Labels are plain-English and are not the official code descriptions. See docs/DATA_VERIFICATION.md. A condition may carry `hint` (a short line shown in the picker) and `includes` (ids of broader conditions whose entries also apply when it is selected).

sources: CMS ICD-10-CM FY2027 code descriptions in tabular order: https://www.cms.gov/files/zip/2027-code-descriptions-tabular-order.zip (linked from https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coding-billing/icd-10-codes)
verification.rule: The conditions list offered to users leaves out any condition whose `verified` value is not "confirmed" or "corrected".

conditions.label: Parkinson disease

codeDescriptions.G20: Parkinson's disease (category header; 7 codes beneath it)

conditions.verifiedAgainst: CMS ICD-10-CM FY2027 code descriptions, file icd10cm_order_2027.txt
conditions.verificationNote: The G20 category also contains G20.C "Parkinsonism, unspecified", which is broader than Parkinson disease.

conditions.label: Heart failure

codeDescriptions.I50: Heart failure (category header; 28 codes beneath it)

conditions.verifiedAgainst: CMS ICD-10-CM FY2027 code descriptions, file icd10cm_order_2027.txt
conditions.verificationNote: Covers all heart failure. Entries the paper limits to reduced ejection fraction belong to the separate condition "heart-failure-reduced-ef".
conditions.hint: Any type of heart failure. Choose this one if you are not sure of the type.

conditions.label: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF)
conditions.hint: Your doctor may have mentioned an ejection fraction number, or called it systolic heart failure.

codeDescriptions.I50.2: Systolic (congestive) heart failure (category header; 4 codes beneath it)
codeDescriptions.I50.4: Combined systolic (congestive) and diastolic (congestive) heart failure (category header; 4 codes beneath it)

conditions.verifiedAgainst: CMS ICD-10-CM FY2027: code descriptions (icd10cm_order_2027.txt) and tabular list (icd10cm_tabular_2027.xml); criterion wording from AGS 2023 Beers Criteria, Table 3, row "Heart failure"
conditions.verificationNote: Added in the follow-up. The CMS tabular list gives "Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction [HFrEF]" as an inclusion term of I50.2, and "Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction and diastolic dysfunction" as an inclusion term of I50.4. I50.3 (diastolic; inclusion term "Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction [HFpEF]") is not included. `includes` means that selecting this condition also applies every entry for general heart failure.

conditions.label: Dementia or cognitive impairment

codeDescriptions.F01: Vascular dementia (category header; 32 codes beneath it)
codeDescriptions.F02: Dementia in other diseases classified elsewhere (category header; 32 codes beneath it)
codeDescriptions.F03: Unspecified dementia (category header; 32 codes beneath it)
codeDescriptions.G30: Alzheimer's disease (category header; 4 codes beneath it)
codeDescriptions.G31.84: Mild cognitive impairment of uncertain or unknown etiology

conditions.verifiedAgainst: CMS ICD-10-CM FY2027 code descriptions, file icd10cm_order_2027.txt
conditions.verificationNote: Does not cover every code for cognitive impairment (for example G31.83, neurocognitive disorder with Lewy bodies; G31.0, frontotemporal dementia; and R41.81, age-related cognitive decline).

conditions.label: Delirium

codeDescriptions.F05: Delirium due to known physiological condition

conditions.verifiedAgainst: CMS ICD-10-CM FY2027 code descriptions, file icd10cm_order_2027.txt
conditions.verificationNote: F05 is "Delirium due to known physiological condition"; substance-induced delirium is coded elsewhere and is not covered.

conditions.label: Syncope (fainting)
conditions.verifiedAgainst: CMS ICD-10-CM FY2027 code descriptions, file icd10cm_order_2027.txt

conditions.label: History of falls or fractures

codeDescriptions.Z87.31: Personal history of (healed) nontraumatic fracture (category header; 3 codes beneath it)

conditions.verifiedAgainst: CMS ICD-10-CM FY2027 code descriptions, file icd10cm_order_2027.txt
conditions.verificationNote: Z87.31 is a category header (nontraumatic fracture) used as a prefix. Current fractures are coded elsewhere and are not covered.

conditions.label: History of stomach or duodenal ulcer

codeDescriptions.K25: Gastric ulcer (category header; 9 codes beneath it)
codeDescriptions.K26: Duodenal ulcer (category header; 9 codes beneath it)
codeDescriptions.K27: Peptic ulcer, site unspecified (category header; 9 codes beneath it)
codeDescriptions.Z87.11: Personal history of peptic ulcer disease

conditions.verifiedAgainst: CMS ICD-10-CM FY2027 code descriptions, file icd10cm_order_2027.txt
conditions.verificationNote: K25 to K27 are current ulcers and Z87.11 is a history of peptic ulcer disease; the paper says "history of gastric or duodenal ulcers". K27 is "peptic ulcer, site unspecified".

conditions.label: Severe kidney disease (creatinine clearance below 30 mL/min)
conditions.verifiedAgainst: CMS ICD-10-CM FY2027 code descriptions, file icd10cm_order_2027.txt; threshold from AGS 2023 Beers Criteria, Table 6
conditions.verificationNote: Label changed from "Chronic kidney disease, stage 4 or higher" to the paper's threshold (creatinine clearance below 30 mL/min). The codes are valid CMS codes for CKD stage 4, stage 5 and end-stage renal disease, but the CMS file does not define the stages by kidney function, so their match to the paper's threshold was NOT verified.

conditions.label: Enlarged prostate with urinary symptoms (BPH)

codeDescriptions.N40.1: Benign prostatic hyperplasia with lower urinary tract symptoms

conditions.verifiedAgainst: CMS ICD-10-CM FY2027 code descriptions, file icd10cm_order_2027.txt
conditions.verificationNote: N40.1 matches the label exactly. N40.3 (nodular prostate with lower urinary tract symptoms) is not covered.

conditions.label: Urinary incontinence (women)

codeDescriptions.N39.4: Other specified urinary incontinence (category header; 11 codes beneath it)

conditions.verifiedAgainst: CMS ICD-10-CM FY2027 code descriptions, file icd10cm_order_2027.txt
conditions.verificationNote: These codes are not sex-specific (N39.3 is "Stress incontinence (female) (male)"); the paper's criterion applies to women. N39.4 is a category header used as a prefix and includes N39.44 nocturnal enuresis.
